description: Timestamped transcript of what is said in a YouTube video, with speaker labels, plus (optionally) the meaningful text shown on screen. Made by Gemini from the audio and frames, so it works without captions. For videos longer than about 30 minutes, request parts with start/end.

detail.description: "low" sends frames at low resolution. It saves tokens only on Gemini 2.5 models; Gemini 3 and newer treat it like the default.

end.description: Analyze up to this point. Same formats as `start`.

include_on_screen_text.description: Also list text shown on screen (slides, titles, code).

start.description: Analyze from this point on. Seconds (90), MM:SS (1:30) or H:MM:SS (1:02:03).

youtube_url.description: YouTube video link (watch, youtu.be, shorts, live or embed) or the 11-character video ID.

name: get_video_transcript
title: Transcribe a YouTube video
